message.content: Hey, users are getting a blank page when they submit the login form. Can you dig in?
Looking now. I'll check the server logs for the submit endpoint.

Found it: every POST to /login is returning HTTP 419. The session middleware in auth.py is rejecting the request because the CSRF token in the form does not match the one in the session cookie -- the login template was caching a stale token from an earlier page load.
Good catch. Can you fix it?

Fixed in auth.py: the CSRF token is now re-issued on every GET /login rather than reused from the cached template fragment. Added a regression test (test_login_csrf_refresh) that posts with a stale token and asserts the request is now retried with a fresh one instead of hard-failing with 419. All tests pass.
